notes.title: Introducing a Quirky Multiplayer Shooter Game From Spiral Up!

We hope you've been enjoying exploring Aurora City! While you are enjoying brewing coffee with Affogato, you may like to check out another game that our publisher, Spiral Up Games has just announced.

In Bang Bang Barrage, you play as a cute, gun-wielding yellow bean fighting against Cthulhu (and its hands) and other dangers in treacherous waters. To succeed, you must master a unique recoil-based movement system, turning gunfights into a strategic dance. Every shot counts. You can set sail alone or with friends, experiencing new adventures with dynamically changing environmental mechanics and supplies from shop boats. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429496/01d6bb51e08c5a65e6c71c7ed5543e6616c4aaea.gif[/img]

Tailor each run with a variety of upgrades and adapt to spontaneous buffs and debuffs that the sea throws at you. Adapt your strategy on the fly and make the most out of unexpected twists and turns.

notes.title: Discover The Magical Witch Cards!
notes.content:
Hello, Magic Apprentices! 

We hope you’ve been having a magical experience in Affogato. As you journey through Arorua City, you’ll soon discover that it's not just your wits and decisions in the café that matter, but also on the mystical battlefield as you delve deeper into the minds of your customers. Here, your Witch cards aren't merely tools; they are your comrades in arms, ready to battle against inner demons. In this article, we’ll be taking you on a Witch Card tour as we showcase some of them, their abilities and how you can acquire them!

[h2]The Moon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/b61de606881a279b95cc7925bcdd4b8a0b3a3a26.gif[/img]
First off, we have The Moon, a Witch card that draws strength as the tides of battle change. Each time an ally falls or is summoned back, it empowers The Moon with random buffs such as HP regeneration, ATK increase, or a Penta charge. This unpredictable advantage keeps your strategies flexible and your opponents guessing. You can acquire The Moon card from Mephista’s shop. 

[h2]The Lovers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/ef3a5bf49d96ab2a3b46f67a24ab619f61f11156.gif[/img]
Next, meet The Lovers. United in adversity, this card is your sword and shield, reflecting damage dealt to them back to the enemy and ensuring that every confrontation is a double-edged clash. In addition, when fully charged, you’ll receive a The Lovers: Stealth card in your inventory which when cast, will bring your team into Stealth state for those decisive, blindsided strikes! You’ll acquire The Lovers card after defeating the Chapter 3 boss.

[h2]Judgment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/fb14c2d5a5b4a6e8d72d4c8ab274104264cc9b35.gif[/img]
Behold Judgment, the luminous avenger. Unlike other Witch card, Judgment does not charge energy through its attacks. Instead, its luminous strikes imprint a Mark of Judgment on enemies. When you stack a total of 3 marks, witness a spectacular explosion of energy, dealing massive damage to the marked enemies. You can acquire the Judgment card from Mephista’s card shop.

[h2]The Empress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/3a8769649131b07efefdd966023d7d82a4ede888.gif[/img]
The Empress is a Witch card that wields a charm like a blade, where each successful strike will provide you with a charge. When fully charged, The Empress: Charm card will be bestowed upon you, adding an edge of seduction and control to your tactical arsenal. You’ll acquire the Empress card after finishing Lindsay’s side story.

[h2]The Sun[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/c4cf37cda8a65772b24a7496ca1af82f34653c73.gif[/img]
And finally, introducing The Sun, a formidable Witch card that has one of the highest Penta summoning costs in the game. However, its unique prowess lies in a dynamic deployment cost, reducing each time with an ally’s sacrifice or strategic withdrawal. But wait - its brilliance doesn't end there! Upon its defeat or withdrawal from the battlefield, it triggers a radiant blast in the surrounding areas, leaving devastation in its wake! The Sun will be available for purchase from Mephista’s card shop after reaching a certain point in the story.

We hope that this Witch card tour has provided you with a glimpse of the distinct power that each card possesses! With over 20 unique Witch cards for you to collect and countless ways to build your very own deck, each battle invites you to an intricate dance of strategy and decision-making. Will you employ The Sun's explosive tendencies, or will you use The Empress' charm to sway the tide of battles?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983970/Affogato/

[h2]New Update: Patch 1.0.19[/h2]

Hold onto your wands because we’ve just rolled out a new update, fresh from the [i]opentest beta branch[/i]! The update includes new phone dialogues with some of our enchanting characters, a new difficulty option, a new level challenge mode, on top of more feature optimizations and bug fixes. 

You can find the full list of updates below:

[h3]Content Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game difficulty adjustment: We’ve added in a new “Normal” difficulty which will ensure a more balanced gameplay. “Normal” difficulty has been renamed to “Hard” difficulty. ”Hard” difficulty has been renamed to “Hell” difficulty.
[*] Added a new mode for players who have completed the game to replay previous reverse tower defense levels.
[*] New phone dialogues have been added for Aoi, Ema, and Hina, further enriching their storylines.
[/list]
[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the Witch Card Shop introduction: Detailed explanations of the witch cards have been added.
[*] When interacting with possessed NPCs, players will now have the option to start the battle through a secondary confirmation button instead of jumping straight into battle.
[*] Optimized the name of some checkpoints in certain levels.
[*] Optimized how checkpoints record the position and order of the Witch Cards.
[*] Increased the probability of triggering the positive effects of the Wheel of Fate. After triggering a negative effect, the next one will be a positive effect.
[*] Optimized “The World" healing target to prioritize units with the lowest percentage of health - not the units with the lowest value of health.
[*] The "Work Till You Die" and "Desensitization Therapy" achievements have been removed.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential issue in the final boss stage on Easy difficulty that could prevent the stage completion.
[*] Fixed the issue where level 2-2 could not be cleared if the enemies in the level are silenced.
[*] Fixed the issue where tasks from the previous week did not disappear in the second week.
[*] Fixed the occasional disappearance of the map, backpack, and phone buttons.
[*] Fixed a glitch in the third segment of the police side plot where making the wrong coffee could freeze the game.
[*] Fixed the issue where the memory effects did not disappear after reading a memory.
[*] Fixed an issue where the selection state of the first character would change when pressing 'F' to add points.
[*] Fixed a bug where players will be able to switch to other cards during the Witch card upgrade tutorial.
[*] Fixed some errors in conversational text and mobile phone news text.
[/list]
We hope you’ll enjoy this latest update! Once again we would like to extend our thanks and appreciation for your unwavering support for Affogato. The feedback and suggestions we have received from the community has been pivotal in our continuous journey of refining the game. 

Lastly, if Affogato has left a lasting impression on you, we'd be honored if you took a moment to review our game on Steam. Spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a lot to us.

notes.title: Exclusive Interview: Crafting Affogato's Enchanting Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices! 🌟

We hope you've been enjoying the magical adventures in Affogato! As you brew the finest coffee and engage in reverse tower battles, we have a special treat just for you. Today, we invite you behind the scenes for an exclusive interview with us, the developers from Befun Studio and the brilliant composer behind Affogato's soul-stirring original soundtrack (OST), Kyfun!

For those who revel in catchy music, here's a preview video that showcases the enchanting tunes you'll hear in the game!

[h2][b]Check out Affogato's Original Soundtrack![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=Rr7HlIkZJmE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]1. Could you briefly introduce the OST of Affogato?[/b][/h3]
Kyfun: The soundtrack of Affogato is a vibrant mix of Acid Jazz, Fusion, and Funk, crafted to give the game a cool, smooth, and energetic feel. Imagine the high-speed thrills of early "Ridge Racer'' games—that’s the sensation that Fusion Jazz can bring to a game! For fans of classic Japanese anime, think of the style and spirit of shows like "R.O.D" or "Cat's Eye". 

[h3][b]2. What kind of experience does Affogato aim to deliver to its audience through its music?[/b][/h3]

Befun Studio: We really adore the music of “Persona” series, and we hoped to steer the game in that musical direction during its production, aiming for a modern, catchy vibe. Moreover, both Kyfun and our team are fond of the jazz band T-SQUARE; and we clicked instantly. During the development, we were also inspired by a game called “Hell Taker,” whose music, combined with the characters' animations, is highly engaging. Throughout the development of Affogato, we aimed to replicate this magical experience through our own character’s animations and Kyfun’s music.

Kyfun: My main goal as a composer was to make sure the music elevates the entire gaming experience. With Affogato, the visuals and certain game settings are reminiscent of “Persona 5”. I felt that pairing this style with Fusion Jazz would capture the unique mechanics of the game. Beyond that, I wanted to create soundtracks that leave a lasting impression, so players might find themselves humming the tunes long after they’ve put the game down!


[h3][b]3. Did you encounter any challenges during the music production? How were they resolved?[/b][/h3]
Kyfun: The initial music compositions I produced were quite emotional and intense. However, the developers preferred a style reminiscent of Motoi Sakuraba's music. I had to revisit and adjust my initial approach, undergo a process of trial and error to refine my music and ensure that it aligned with both the game’s requirements and my personal style. Over time, I managed to strike a balance where my music compositions not only met the developers' expectations but also stayed true to my artistic vision!

[h3][b]4. Which piece of music is your favorite?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/6934a953eff878424cd7675d326675ec742993e3.gif[/img]
Befun Studio: My personal favorite is “Glorious Jubilee,” the background music for the Jubilee Arcade venue. Jubilee Arcade is modeled after a Chinese street, so in Western Fusion style, we tried to integrate some Chinese elements, utilizing traditional Chinese instruments when composing the music. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/5d2d273d0ea2349e6c716d454dca4ea8b1f04a4a.gif[/img]

Kyfun: I love “In Your Mind” the most. It is the background music of one of the core elements of the game – the reverse tower defense battles. Given that it is likely the most frequently played track, I aimed to make it memorable and enjoyable, even after repeated listening. To achieve this, I adopted a variety of strategies in the composition, making certain sections complex and others simple and catchy, depending on the accompanying chord and bass progressions. My goal for this track is to resonate with jazz/fusion enthusiasts while being accessible and engaging to those unfamiliar with these genres.

[h3][b]5. Is there anything else you would like to say about the music?[/b][/h3]
Befun Studio: I hope everyone can enjoy the enchanting melodies of Affogato and that more people will come to appreciate this Fusion Jazz style!

Kyfun: Crafting the music for Affogato was a truly enjoyable journey for me! It allowed me to break free from my usual niche of classical Chinese and orchestral pieces. I genuinely hope the game and its soundtrack resonates with everyone who experiences it!

notes.title: Affogato - The Magic Behind Our Battle System!
notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices! 

As you know - in Affogato - you play the role of a sorceress managing a bustling café in the enchanting city of Arorua, interacting with a diverse array of customers to learn about troubles and woes. You will then venture into the deepest recess of their minds to engage in epic reverse tower defense battles to defeat the inner demons that torment them. 

In this article, we’re zooming in on our reverse tower defense battle mechanic. We will discuss what makes it special and how we have designed it to give you a unique gameplay experience in Affogato!

[h2]Traditional Tower Defense vs. Reverse Tower Defense
[/h2]

Before that, let’s take a step back to the traditional tower defense genre. Typically, tower defense games have a simple idea - build a strong line of defense and halt the advance of enemy troops. With each wave, you would have to identify weak spots and bolster your defenses, making sure no enemy gets through. It's a thrilling setup, one that we've grown to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/526f4f432aa5dffea84292e0577bd0614ac32e70.gif[/img]

However, here’s an exciting twist for you to think about.. Imagine being on the other side of this battlefield for once. Picture yourself not as the steadfast defender, but as the bold attacker, the one who takes the battle to the enemy. Instead of passively awaiting the onslaught, you’re actively dismantling defenses, breaking lines, and leading the charge. This is the core essence of the reverse tower defense battles in Affogato, a unique approach that flips the traditional concept on its head!

[h2]Mastering Reverse Tower Defense in Affogato
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/e19a1775e55cd92fc0f1a80359c70ca3a74bcfe9.gif[/img]
[i]The Chariot is an armored Witch Card that takes damage for the team!
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/3e543cecc8ea07bba44001861284ea34861065bb.gif[/img]
[i]The Strength charges up each hit and unleashes a devastating strike once fully charged!
[/i]
At the heart of these mental battles in Affogato lies your arsenal of weapons called the Witch Cards, a selection of powerful allies waiting to be summoned. Each Witch Card possesses its own unique abilities and powers, allowing you to customize your battle strategy. For example, you might require a robust armored warrior to hold the line and absorb enemy damage at critical moments. Or perhaps a swift striker who charges ahead, throwing the enemy's defenses into disarray. This is where your decision-making and in-the-moment adaptations truly come to life in Affogato!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/91e7a25bc0a873f23120d5e562b08157311695c9.gif[/img]
[i]Strategize your battle path wisely!
[/i]
Navigating through these battles isn’t just about your offensive line-up, though. To secure victory in each stage, you’ll need to outwit the defenses which take the form of enemy “towers”. Unlike the traditional single-path approach often seen in tower defense games, we’ve spiced things up with multiple pathways in each stage, adding a twist of strategy and unpredictability to your game plan. Choosing a path could be the difference between resounding victory and crushing defeat, so make sure you strategize it well!

We hope this peek into Affogato's unique reverse tower defense mechanic has got you as excited as we are! Over the next few months, we've got some fantastic updates planned that we can't wait to share with you, including our official launch, so be sure to stay tuned!

Today, we're thrilled to introduce you to one of Affogato's most enigmatic characters, Sera, the mysterious witch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/01f6f61ad02f1d95ff8b207b6fcb1e10b1355591.gif[/img]

notes.title: Affogato - Development Progress and Updates!
notes.content:

When we released the Affogato demo during Steam Next Fest in February 2023, we received loads of amazing feedback and suggestions, and we can't thank you enough for your patience in playing our game. We appreciate the diversity of your questions and have been more than happy to address as many as possible. Some suggestions were challenging, but they were also very interesting and valuable for our development process! 

As such, we are excited to present an update on Affogato's development, and share the improvements we've made so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/ab071ea8f8acb53085540862cc80dc2b9afdb5a4.png[/img]

[h2]Side Quests for Natalie & Lindsay[/h2]
Do you remember Natalie and Lindsay from our demo? Natalie is a senior journalist running the "Goddess Chronicles" in Arorua City, and Lindsay is a college student with social anxiety, looking for a part-time job to help her develop her social skills. Currently, the development of Natalie and Lindsay's side quests has been completed, and we believe the events surrounding them will bring surprises to you! We are still in the midst of developing other characters' side quests which including some male characters that we will be introducing soon!

In Affogato, each character you encounter holds a significant importance in the game, and it's up to you to determine how to develop relationships with them. Every choice you make can shape your adventure, leading to a variety of potential outcomes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/df5d441bbe26293e127beaf4ef8b155ee1e8edb3.png[/img]

In response to players' feedback on the battle difficult level, we initially introduced various difficulty options to cater to different preferences, however we noticed that some of you still find certain challenges demanding. As such, we have made some adjustments to the battle mechanics, and our quality control team is currently testing these changes. We have also enhanced the special effects and art for the third and fourth chapter battle levels, making them more visually rich and stimulating.

notes.title: Affogato Dev Q&A Issue #2
notes.content:
[b]Hello Reverse Tower Defenders![/b]

In our previous Q&A we addressed some general questions. In this issue of our Dev Q&A we will be fielding some questions regarding the game design and the premise of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/7ce5a4fd2f4719dc0fdc46e0fc9281df3b839b11.png[/img]

[b]Q - Would you refresh everyone on the background story of Affogato please?

[/b]A - Absolutely! The plot revolves around a good witch called Affogato who visits a magical city called Arorua which doesn't ever see daylight and decides to call it home. There, she becomes the boss of a cafe and holds a double identity as a demon buster, helping her customers defeat their inner demons and overcoming personal challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/18600465aa0fe5bcc7d51db4be0a8c4e91a503e0.png[/img]

[b]Q - Who is the mysterious white-haired girl who appeared at the end of the demo? Is she also a witch?

[/b]A - Her name is Aoi and she has the same demonic powers as Affogato. But Affogato probably wouldn't call her a witch after helping Aoi out of some trouble (Spoiler Alert!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/c35c27b2c1443c3c9211b6d49a06afff823e46c6.png[/img]

[b]Q - Tell us more about the game! In the demo, there are several stages we could challenge. But there are very few locations we can visit in Arorua City. And although there are some shops, interaction is very limited. In the actual release of the game, would there be opportunities to interact more with the shops? And if so, how would these be integrated into the core gameplay?

[/b]A - Affogato is a story-rich game. We have planned for 4 Acts and 5 NPC plotlines.
In the game, shops play a role where players can visit them to increase their in-game statistics, which would in turn affect how the game progresses. For example, if you lack Courage points you would not be able to interact with a NPC and therefore not be able to unlock that particular storyline.

We have designed Affogato such that there is a finite amount of time you can spend within a game day, so that gamers will have to make decisions on how to best allocate it and juggle between improving their stats, pursuing the main storyline or exploring side quests and nurturing relationships with NPCs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/c0c88957922470cdcc587f1027eac4d3b6294f1e.png[/img]

[b]Q - What are the key themes of Affogato?

[/b]A - Magic, coffee, demons, hope.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/fee5c83f9d0d3f93a1e8b4f736eb04c705fde2f3.png[/img]

[b]Q - How many key characters are there in Affogato?

[/b]A - At the moment, we are planning for 4 lead characters and 5 supporting characters. Gamers can make coffee for them, fight their inner demons and solve their problems, establish friendships with them and ultimately save Arorua City together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/8413585e3f5de8aed814babc020c6161ddb6240b.jpg[/img]
[i]Above - A Version 0.1 mockup of a Battle Stage[/i]

[b]Q - The 'reverse tower defense' genre is pretty niche. How are you tackling the battle system considering there are few references for this genre?

[/b]A - We began production with just a few monsters and direction changing tiles. Later on, we added more complex monsters and other mechanics - such as Charm, Change the World, etc. We also improved on the animation, environmental designs and effects.

Later on, we added Branch Missions and Daily Missions to add more variety to gameplay. The Branch Missions allow gamers to experience the different playing styles the numerous witches provide and the Daily Missions allow gamers to interact with the game on a deeper level. Experienced players will naturally get better rewards and less experienced ones can eventually work their way up to becoming more proficient as well.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/51b17eec08c4a3e0b16e5d8ecabb6c733f3613c0.gif[/img]

An innovation we tried in the initial stages of production was to let players use defeated monsters to help them in battles. However, this design would prove to be very restrictive and we eventually found a compromise in the form of the Witch Card The Empress. This arrangement allows the defeated monsters to become temporary allies without making the gameplay too restrictive. 

We also found that while the direction changing tiles is a great idea, it causes the team members to split up. To resolve this issue, we made it such that they would team up again when they bump into one another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/3fe36418b259f0c3fb152c638c18ac2a183d19cc.gif[/img]

[b]Q - In this process, what difficulties did you face?

[/b]A - Honestly quite a bit. One key challenge was that reverse tower defense games are few and far between, and it was a challenge to find any games we could take reference from. We have to depend pretty much on our own creativity and feedback from the early stage game testers to improve on and iterate the game design. In the earlier stages, we suffered from developer's tunnel vision syndrome and what we thought would work turned out to be too complicated for the gamers. Fortunately, you guys really gave us great feedback and we were able to pinpoint and work on those issues. We look forward to what you guys think of our upcoming demo which we will release in late January!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/9b441fedf59d56ca0333e9f60ea4b4d61c6848df.png[/img]
[i]Above - The team is hard at work looking for bugs to squash.
[/i]

[b]Q - Any more interesting trivia you can share with us on your game design?

[/b]A - When we first worked on the game, we imagined that Affogato would share many similarities to Anomaly: Warzone Earth as it is also a reverse tower defense game. Interestingly, that didn't turn out to be so as fundamentally our game premise is very different and that naturally created differentiation in our game mechanics. For example, we allow ingame characters to split up and move about freely on the battle maps. This gives us the opportunity to design the battles in such a way that players can take down the bosses through innovative ways. They can choose to split up their team members to spread out and dilute the damage that is dealt to them, or move around the boss strategically to attack it from different angles. 

That's all for Issue #2 of Affogato's Q&A! If you have other burning questions of your own, please feel free to ask them in the comments section below, and do follow us on our socials!

notes.title: Affogato Dev Q&A Issue #1
notes.content:
Hello Reverse Tower Defenders!

As we work hard to get Affogato ready for launch, we will be increasing our frequency of posts on Steam so that you know what we are up to.

We will also be starting a regular Q&A issue where we will be answering some questions we receive from you!

Let's go!
---

[b]Q - What is a reverse tower defense game and why do you call Affogato one?[/b]

A - In traditional tower defense games, enemies move around your lead character(s) while you stay rooted, trying to prevent them from reaching an end point. In a reverse tower defense game, it is exactly the opposite - where your enemies stay rooted and you lead your main character(s) toward an end point. 
We want to give credit to 11bit Studio's Anomaly: Warzone Earth for probably being the first game to adopt the reverse tower defense concept.

In our opinion, Affogato is a little more than just a reverse tower defense game. We added some of our own secret sauce to make the game more challenging, such as adding Blocking Seal on battle map to provide short term goals, adding Challenge Targets for players who want a challenge, adding elite boss battle for the most intense and exciting game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/54402aa11c0d10e59440440748b542fbbfede2c6.png[/img]

[b]Q - The demo is really difficult. Will the actual game be just as tough?[/b]

A - In the actual game release, there will be 3 difficulty levels to choose from. The lowest difficulty will be suitable for gamers who are more keen on being able to complete the game and understand the story plot without going through too much of a challenge. The highest difficulty will be for players who want to put themselves up for a challenge against tougher monsters and puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/df5d441bbe26293e127beaf4ef8b155ee1e8edb3.png[/img]

[b]Q - Would Affogato support gamepads?[/b]

A - We will do our best! We are trying to work through some kinks at the moment. We started off making the game for the keyboard and mouse. Compared to the gamepad, the keyboard and mouse combo provides more keys and better control when it comes to the coffee making simulation and choosing where you want to go during battle. So it is a bit of a challenge trying to make the game work on the gamepad, but try we will! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/8c6ebd6c1ad45074db25ff8e34c51d770991415f.jpg[/img]

[b]Q - Can you tell us more about Arorua City and the people staying in it?[/b]

A - Arorua City was originally an ordinary city by the sea. 6 years ago, a fate changing event caused the city to plunge into eternal night and since then, all sorts of people from various walks of life have chosen to come here and call it their home. This includes Affogato who has set up her café here. Besides humans, Arorua also houses lots of Kemonomimi - which are aborigines of this city. The two races live in harmony, albeit with occasional friction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/8ca2283b85f0ab07570c8557a1549a5d5a8bfdd2.jpg[/img]

[b]Q - Why do you use Tarot cards to demonstrate the witches' abilities?[/b]

A - We decided to use Tarot cards due to their diversity and large number - 78 to be exact. In Affogato, there are a lot of characters you can summon during battle, hence using Tarot makes sense. Although we are in fact using Tarot, we have avoided calling it that to avoid religious controversy and conflict, hence we now call it Witch Cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/be6be63e4e736bf902025479f5cf8f68b559ac48.png[/img]

[b]Q - I understand that the game is going to feature several witches. Can you divulge some information about the abilities of the other girls? Does only Affogato have the ability to enter the deep recesses of a person's mind and soul?[/b]

A - Indeed, the game is going to feature several witches apart from Affogato and Sera who are in the demo, and each one of them has her own unique ability. Affogato is the only girl with the ability to enter a person's mind and that makes her the perfect candidate to resolve a person's troubles. We cannot talk about Sera's powers unfortunately, as that would be a spoiler. 

However, here's a little snippet of some witches you will meet in the demo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/76d9ef14cf5e101c2b1598a50adaffd2a6e7e247.png[/img]

That's all for Issue #1 of Affogato's Q&A! If you have other burning questions of your own, please feel free to ask them in the comments section below, and do follow us on our socials!

notes.title: Coffee, Sorceress and Reversed Tower Defense - The Trailer for "Affogato"
notes.content:
Finally, the day comes - Real-time Tactical Card Battler RPG meets Coffee Shop Management in a Supernatural Anime Universe. The brand new Reversed Tower Defense JRPG #Affogato# developed by Befun Studio has released its first official trailer!
Play Affogato demo for free from the 29th of July on Steam! Enjoy your daily life as the magenta-haired sorceress Affgato in Arorua City! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/795583d59fcaa08d7c10b656f7932a6f46ab3601.png[/img]

Key Features:
Brand New Reversed Tower Defense System with Cards. 

Reversed tower defense combat awaits once players step into the mind of a wicked customer. It's a system that combines various card-game mechanics: choose the best cards for each stage, evaluate their cost, the route to take, and how to best use the skill and item cards in real time.

Build Unique Friendships by Helping Customers.

Get to know customers of all varieties, hear their stories, step into their minds and solve what's troubling them. You can even pursue closer relationships with those you feel attracted to! There are 6 NPCs with whom you can interact, each with a whopping 10,000 words of unique storylines.

Schedule Your Daily life as a Sorceress. 

Manage your time wisely. Will you focus on your cafe's profit? Or on your friendships with each customer? Or maybe you're more interested in creating the strongest deck you can? Or perhaps all of the above! Every action costs time in Affogato. Once the clock hits 12 PM, the next day will roll around, so you'll need to plan each day with care.

Climb the Career Ladder of Professional Coffee Baristas

Making a good cuppa is the foundation of being a barista. To be a truly great barista, however, you need to weigh up a customer's words and judge which brew is perfect for them. Bring a smile with every cup you make! Affogato features realistic coffee-making simulation in which you'll need to familiarize yourself with the workings of various equipment to make your brew. Different flavors and blends will have knock-on effects on the storyline dialogue.
